name: Ninjago Brick Slicer
author: JensOlesen
description:
Master Wu want you to train, by slicing the bricks with your weapon.
BUT beware, if you miss them it gets harder !. There are a few special bricks that can help you.
Hope you enjoy the game :-) /Jens Olesen [JensODK]

Instructions:
Click SPACE to Start the game.
Then the game will rotate between the ninjas. When your favorite ninja is highlighted click SPACE to select it.
You will see bricks falling from the sky, click SPACE to rotate your ninja to slice the bricks.
If you miss, the bricks will elevate the platform you stand on.
If you get so elevated that you touch the Hazard behavioral brick at top, its game over.
There are certain special bricks:
1) Red brick with bomb : If you hit it with sword its game over. However if you let it hit floor, it will remove some of the bricks under your platform
2) Blue brick with clock : If you hit this, the drop rate will slow down for a few seconds.
3) Green brick with Heart : This will summon a few friends to help you for a few seconds.
